Stripe webhook event fixtures in the Stripe API format (version 2026-09-30), trimmed to the
fields the handler reads plus common context fields. Ids end in TEST; no real Stripe account
was used. `USER_ID` is replaced by the test with the signed-in user's id.

Period 1: 1790000000 to 1792592000. Period 2 (renewal): 1792592000 to 1795270400.
